body:
I’m delighted to let you know that our beloved children’s book Cory and the Seventh Story is now available as an ebook, along with the book of essays The Seventh Story: Us, Them, and the End of Violence. People tell us that these books have made a real difference in the way they think about how to understand, live in, and make the world better for all of us. You can get the ebook of Cory exclusively at www.theseventhstory.com.

BTW – if you loved Cory and the Seventh Story, here’s some additional news. We’re seeking a publisher for Cory along with two sequels. Stay tuned for updates.

And I want to recommend another children’s book by Laura Alary and Sue Todd: Mira and the Big Story. It’s a “kindred book” to Cory and the Seventh Story. More info here: https://www.amazon.com/Mira-Big-Story-Laura…/dp/1558966935 .
